name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower | Blue Dream
description:
A legendary West Coast sativa-leaning hybrid, Blue
Dream blends the cerebral clarity of Haze with the
deep body calm of Blueberry. Its buds offer a
fragrant swirl of sweet berry and herbal spice, paired
with a high that lifts the mind while gently grounding
the body — a perfect
harmony between inspiration and ease.
Why It Belongs in Chronicles:
Chronicles is a collection for strains that tell a story
— and Blue Dream is a classic chapter. It represents
the modern cannabis era: creative, balanced, and
universally beloved. Its legacy as a daytime favorite
with deep roots in California breeding history makes
it a cornerstone entry in the Chronicles
series — a strain that’s both familiar
and worthy of remembrance.
